alex: quick sync — noticed GPU leases not reclaimed after TTL expired; causing slow scale-down yesterday

 t ess: ugh, saw that. any logs? :eyes:

alex: pasted tail from operator:
```
I0323 14:05:01 lease_controller.go:123] lease id=abc123 expired at 1719214200, reclaim deferred: active_prewarm=true
I0323 14:05:03 lease_controller.go:130] failed to transition lease abc123 -> RECLAIMED: conflict
```

matt: conflict likely due to concurrent state update from prewarm-admitter. saw similar in canary last week

srini: is prewarm-admitter supposed to extend TTL? current code does `if prewarm && !warm { lease.ttl += 120 }` — that's racy

alex: yep exactly. two problems: (1) we treat TTL as a best-effort field, not authoritative; (2) operator uses optimistic update with no event ordering

ops-bot: deploy/gpu-operator v2.7.4 rolled at 2024-11-16T02:00Z

tess: proposal: make lease transitions idempotent and add an intermediate `INVALIDATING` state before RECLAIMED so prewarm can attach/detach atomically

matt: +1 on idempotency. also prefer event-sourced reconciliation: operator applies events `PREWARM_ATTACH`, `PREWARM_DETACH`, `LEASE_EXPIRE` and processes them serially

srini: downside: event log adds complexity and storage. alternative: leader-elected handoff where prewarm agent writes a claim, operator reads claims and reconciles TTL as single source

alex: thinking: minimal change -> change TTL semantics to be immutable once set; prewarm can request `extend` via an explicit API which returns CAS token. operator uses CAS to update to avoid conflicts

jamie: can we also add a short-term observability metric: `lease_conflict_count` and emit traces when CAS fails? would help debugging

tess: agreed. rollout plan:
1) add `lease_conflict_count` metric + trace hooks (canary)
2) implement CAS-based extend endpoint (backwards compatible)
3) add `INVALIDATING` state if CAS fails repeatedly (>3 times) and start async reclaim
4) consider event log if contention remains

matt: quick question: how long should CAS retry before giving up? 3 attempts with exponential backoff (50ms, 200ms, 800ms)?

srini: sounds reasonable. also set a global cap so retries don't block scale-down longer than 5s

alex: I'll draft a small PR with CAS API + metric instrumentation. tagging you all. ping if you want to pair on tests.

tess: awesome. also add e2e with simulated concurrent prewarm attach to reproduce

matt: :thumbsup:

ops-bot: issue #8421 created: `lease-cas-extend-and-metrics` by alex

alex: thanks — will link PR once ready
